output.summary: KEP-3685 moves the EndpointSlice reconciler and its dependencies from pkg/controller/endpointslice into staging/src/k8s.io/endpointslice so out-of-tree controllers can import it as a Go module, with public NewReconciler/Reconcile, a configurable managedBy label, and split diff-computation from diff-application. Status: implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale:
Custom EndpointSlice controllers struggle to implement the fan-out reconciling correctly, and forked or rewritten copies of the reconciler are hard to support. Sharing a maintained library also eases migration from Endpoints to EndpointSlices for custom controllers. The KEP accepts added maintenance burden from splitting code across pkg/controller and staging as the cost.</rationale>

alternatives.option: Externalize the entire EndpointSlice controller and use alternate data sources (informers) to customize behavior.
alternatives.why_not: The readme lists this only as an alternative and gives no stated reason for rejecting it.

evidence.quote: Move the EndpointSlice reconciler and it’s dependencies to staging so that the reconciler logic be reused by out-of-tree EndpointSlice controllers.
The fanout behavior is difficult to implement correctly and the current reconciler code has gone through several iterations to reach its currently level of robustness.
Allow for the value of the `endpointslice.kubernetes.io/managed-by` label to be configurable by adding `managedBy` as an argument to `NewReconciler`.
This change will add some maintenance burden to the EndpointSlice controller as its code will be spread across `pkg/controller` and `staging`.
